name: zvideo_bind_renderer_dispatch
description: zVideo::BindRendererDispatch selects the renderer path, stores the fullscreen option, installs the renderer dispatch table, and clears cached hardware feature flags for redetection.
known_limits: VC5SP3 11.00.7022 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 COFF byte compare now passes with zero unmasked mismatches after masking COFF relocation bytes; the code/function Reimplemented [S] marker remains globally deferred while authored owner/data gates remain open elsewhere.

The renderer-dispatch data-symbol checks are split across zvideo_renderer_dispatch_core_globals, surface_globals, image_globals, texture_globals, fog_poly_globals, and flush_globals to stay within the BN bridge call budget.
The native smoke verifies renderer/active-path/fullscreen state, selected dispatch slots, Direct3D texture creation binding, DirectDraw blit binding, and selected hardware feature-flag clearing.
